title: 1722. Minimize Hamming Distance After Swap Operations

examples.explanation: source can be transformed the following way: - Swap indices 0 and 1: source = [2,1,3,4] - Swap indices 2 and 3: source = [2,1,4,3] The Hamming distance of source and target is 1 as they differ in 1 position: index 3.
There are no allowed swaps. The Hamming distance of source and target is 2 as they differ in 2 positions: index 1 and index 2.

hints: The source array can be imagined as a graph where each index is a node and each allowedSwaps[i] is an edge.
Nodes within the same component can be freely swapped with each other.
For each component, find the number of common elements. The elements that are not in common will contribute to the total Hamming distance.
